notes.title: Update 0.1.27
notes.content: The playtest has been updated to the current demo build. There have been minor changes to the way the calculations are shown and the available experts.

notes.title: The Next Fest Demo is Live!
notes.content:
The Next Fest demo for AAA Simulator has gone public! You can still play the playtest (and signups will be open to the public again after Next Fest), but I prefer you get the demo and wishlist on the main page. I will still be doing bug fixes as I see fit, but the Next Fest demo shouldn't change too much from now on.

The demo has quite a bit of content, but it's only about a quarter of the full game. Here are some features of the demo vs. the full version:

[list]
[*]Studio Upgrades - around 20 in the demo, 100 in the full version
[*]Experts - around 25 in the demo, 150 in the full version
[*]Favors - 7 in the demo, 20-25 in the full version
[*]Plot - 1 Act in the demo, 3 Acts in the full version
[*]Plus likely hundreds of events to come!
[/list]

I would love to hear any feedback you have, so don't be afraid to reach out!

notes.title: Update 0.1.23 May 27, 2025
notes.content:
A lot of changes this time, most of them small.

[list]
[*]Big Fan will no longer quit when a certain number of employees are fired
[*]Management Consultant has been removed for the crime of causing too many bugs
[*]Changes to the narrative framing and tutorial, including new text, events, and a new label on the shareholders to signify them as "The Board"
[*]Other font and visual changes to disguise it to look more like a proper game
[/list]

notes.title: Major Bug Fix/Update 0.1.21 May 23, 2025
notes.content:
Oops, let a huge bug go unnoticed. Experts weren't adjusting hype for a while, but the bug is fixed now.

Other changes:
[list]
[*]New experts Evan and Todd, who give bonuses whenever an odd or even number of workers do work, respectively
[*]Display bugs for expert floating numbers were fixed
[*]Totals now have a rolling count up effect, and more steps have been added to the calculation UI so it's clearer what is happening
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.18 (May 21, 2025)
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Mouseover animations have been fixed
[*]Several bugs involving the radius and collision detection of Micromanagement have been fixed
[*]Minor UI appearance changes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.17
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Patriarch reported amounts in % instead of $
[*]The term "Daily Sales" has been changed to "Sales" or "Sales per Turn" to reflect the new turn-based time increments
[*]Fixed a bug where tooltips steadily expanded in size over time
[*]Other visual bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.16
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Warren fixed so that he increases by 1% per designer instead of 1x
[*]Logistics Coordinator now increases Max Sales by $1 million per turn
[*]Various UI tweaks and visibility fixes
[*]Other bug fixes you probably didn't notice, but I definitely did
[*]A bug has been introduced where modifier tooltips steadily grow throughout the game. I'll fix it ASAP
[/list]

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.11
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Unlockable Experts are back, with the previous bug fixed
[*]A new Expert, Indie Darling, has been added with unlock conditions
[*]Some minor font and alignment changes have been made
[*]The Warren Expert has been buffed to increment by 1% per designer hired (instead of 0.1%)
[*]Two new Office Upgrades have been added to the Kitchen area
[/list]

notes.title: Revert to previous version
notes.content: Reverted to stable build due to a soft lock bug where the store could not be properly loaded (apologies!)
